black bean soup

2 tbsp olive oil
1 yellow onion, chopped
1 red bell pepper chopped
3 garlic cloves, minced
cumin and chili powder, 1 tsp each
2 (15oz) cans black beans, rinsed
1 can rotel
3 c chix broth
juice of 1 lime

sour cream
chopped cilantro
tortilla chips

Cook the onion and pepper in the oil until soft, about 6 min. Add the garlic and spices for 30 seconds. Add the beans, rotel and broth and simmer for a bit. Blend about half the soup and stir it back in. Stir in the lime juice. Serve with the toppings.
